candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return tx.origin instead of the stored _owner, altering the observable owner value.
Removed the check preventing transferring ownership to zero address by deleting the require; allows transferOwnership(address(0)).
Added an extra check that disallows transferring ownership to the current owner (no-op) by requiring newOwner != _owner.
Changed onlyOwner to compare against tx.origin instead of _msgSender, altering which callers are authorized.
Return the inverted paused state by returning !_paused instead of _paused.
Change setKeeper to require onlyOwner removed (no longer restricted) and emit different KeeperUpdated value by setting keeper to address(0) instead of provided _keeper.
Modify setKeeper so it sets keeper to msg.sender rather than the provided _keeper (and keeps onlyOwner restriction removed).
Change onlyOwner modifier to invert check so it requires caller NOT be owner, allowing non-owner callers to pass and possibly change keeper.
Replace assignment to slippageThresholdGmxBps with assignment that adds 1 (off-by-one change).
Replace assignment to slippageThresholdGmxBps with assignment to zero, ignoring the input.
Replace assignment to slippageThresholdGmxBps with assignment to the maximum basis points, overriding the input.
Remove the owner check by making onlyOwner no-op (drops the require), allowing anyone to call setThresholds and thus change observable state from different callers.
After staking, increment dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance by one more (add +1) instead of exactly glpStaked to change recorded balance.
After staking, do not increase dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance (remove the addition) so the recorded balance is unchanged by this deposit.
Invert paused check so functions with whenNotPaused require the contract to be paused, allowing depositToken to execute only when paused and thus altering when dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance is updated.
Relax the onlyDnGmxJuniorVault guard to allow calls from anyone by removing the require, enabling external callers to call depositToken and change dnGmxJuniorVaultGlpBalance.
